title: Sharp Identification of Group-Time Treated Effects under Misclassified Adoption Timing
banked_reason: The note proves the advertised necessary-and-sufficient witness characterization and simultaneous causal completion, but exact optimization is confined to the T=3 exactly-recorded-never-treatment block; the authoritative cold referee graded subfield (ceiling 6.6 below 7.4) and found no bounded same-topic salvage.
gap_reasons: The class-general result remains an implicit latent-variable feasibility formulation rather than a tractable structural certificate.

Exact optimization is delivered only for the narrow three-period channel block that records never-treatment exactly; once that restriction fails, the note supplies only a counterexample to recorded-control substitution and leaves certification unresolved.

The rational polygon and quadratic-edge results are exact within that block, but their practical significance is supported only by synthetic examples, with no implementation or substantive sensitivity analysis.
proof_attempt_summary: The run established an exact finite witness characterization and a constructive causal completion that realizes every feasible group-time ATT jointly, then derived an observable polygon, an exhaustive variation-independence frontier, and a vertex-plus-quadratic-edge support certificate for the T=3 exactly-recorded-control block. It also produced sharp incompatible-endpoint, irrational-interior-optimum, and one-link control-coupling examples. The mathematics passed review, but a tractable structural certificate for the general audited channel class and a substantive implementation or sensitivity analysis remain separate research programs, so the package achieved subfield rather than the fixed field floor.
tldr: Under actual-path nondifferential recording \(R\perp Y(G)\mid G\), the complete binary panel law is compatible with the causal model exactly when \(\mathcal W(p,\mathfrak M,\eta)\) is nonempty for the preregistered maintained class \(\mathfrak M\) of column-stochastic channels. Every feasible witness has one simultaneous causal completion, without any compactness, semialgebraicity, rationality, or rank condition. The sharp witness-image identities are equally class-general; semialgebraicity holds when \(\mathfrak M\) is semialgebraic, compactness when it is compact, and extrema are attained when it is compact and the witness set is nonempty. The three-period exactly recorded-control results specialize to \(\mathfrak M_{\mathcal A}=\{M(a,b):(a,b)\in\mathcal A\}\), while the arbitrary-channel rank/face-local question specializes to \(\mathfrak M=\mathcal P\) and remains future work.
gap: Current DiD misclassification work identifies or bounds scalar effects under two-period designs, restricted switching patterns, exclusions, or homogeneity. General misclassification and real-algebraic theory already supply common-matrix equations and decidability, but they do not establish simultaneous causal completion, law-specific variation independence, or a six-channel-coordinate exact certificate for the joint ATT image.
fill: Prove the finite causal completion and the repaired block polygon/frontier/certificate package; use the exact one-link obstruction to constrain any extension; then either construct the explicitly bounded rank/face-local algorithm or prove that the defined certificate class cannot be complete.
